exposure: reference to physical or verbal violence/neglect during delivery
outcome: Breastfeeding in the first hour of life
cohort: 1,027 mothers and their children under one year of age attending the second stage of the polio vaccination campaign in the Federal District, Brazil, in 2011
finding: Inadequate prenatal care, cesarean section, and lack of access to rooming-in after birth were negatively associated with breastfeeding in the first hour of life.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was negatively associated with breastfeeding in the first hour of life.
